verdict.rationale: The Division documents online tools to check the status of a return and refund, and offers a public Business Licenses Simple Search. The evidence never shows how status lookup works, and the probe found that registration and filing activity sits behind an authenticated portal session rather than public pages. Missing for 10: confirmed status lookup on public, unauthenticated pages; status visibility for business license applications and business tax filings (gross receipts, withholding); any hands-on corroboration of the status tool.
